gen_risks.description: Difficulty in collaboration with sector partners
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish clear communication channels and regular meetings with sector partners
gen_risks.evidence: The programme's success depends on... effective collaboration with the sector partners

gen_risks.description: Uncertainty in funding for future years
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive funding plan and engage with HM Treasury
gen_risks.evidence: Funding for future years will be agreed separately through business cases

gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a detailed project timeline and monitor progress regularly
gen_risks.evidence: The programme will start national rollout in year 1 by funding EA schools, NSBP schools and a new cohort, with future cohorts staggered

gen_risks.mitigation: Provide incentives and support for eligible schools to participate
gen_risks.evidence: Schools with 40% or more FSM 'Ever 6' pupils will be eligible to apply for a place

gen_risks.mitigation: Monitor policy changes and engage with relevant stakeholders
gen_risks.evidence: The Children's Wellbeing and Schools Bill will place a duty on state-funded schools to offer a breakfast club

gen_risks.description: Difficulty in meeting school food standards
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide guidance and support for schools to meet food standards
gen_risks.evidence: Food provided must be in line with school food standards

gen_risks.mitigation: Develop a recruitment plan and provide training for staff
gen_risks.evidence: The programme's success depends on... the availability of skilled staff and resources

gen_risks.description: Delays in approval and budget confirmation from HM Treasury
gen_risks.mitigation: Engage with HM Treasury and develop a contingency plan
gen_risks.evidence: The programme's success depends on... timely approval and budget confirmation from HM Treasury

gt_risks.description: Lower value for money compared to the 'do minimum' option in year 1, due to the shorter funding period available for the preferred option's new cohorts of schools.
Delivery risks around staffing and food costs for schools newly onboarded to the free breakfast clubs programme.
gt_risks.mitigation: Mitigated through early adopter (EA) scheme insights and support funding.

gt_risks.description: Uncertainty in the labour-market benefits (parental workforce participation gains) the programme is expected to deliver.
gt_risks.mitigation: Addressed through conservative assumptions in the economic modelling.
